title: Truffle Luxury Board
seo_title: Truffle Charcuterie Board for 6–10: Luxury Shopping List
description: A truffle luxury charcuterie board for 6–10: 24-month Comté, truffle pecorino, Époisses, Brillat-Savarin, jamón ibérico, shaved black truffle and truffle honey.
hook: The most decadent board in the first book: shaved truffle, jamón ibérico and four serious cheeses.
why: Truffle is shaved at the table over the Comté and the triple-crème, which is the moment people remember. Aged Comté, truffle pecorino and pungent Époisses already share earthy, savory notes with truffle, so it makes them taste bigger.
Jamón ibérico, with its marbled fat, carries the truffle aroma beautifully, and lean bresaola gives a deep-red contrast. Truffle honey on the triple-crème is the single best bite on the board.

timeline.what: Take out all the cheeses; prep the truffle.
Arrange the board; set the gold leaf if using.
Add the meats; set out the honey and balsamic.
Shave the truffle; add the microgreens.

faq.a: Aged Comté, Pecorino, Époisses and triple-crème cheeses. A truffle-studded pecorino puts it right in the cheese.

faq.q: Do I need a fresh truffle?
faq.a: No. A jarred truffle, truffle cheese and truffle honey give the flavor for much less. Fresh black truffle is the splurge.
Nebbiolo, aged Champagne or a white Burgundy.
